name: Forbidden Desire
description: In the 1930s, in Passaperto, the powerful Cândida controls the family until the arrival of Laura, considered a miracle, who awakens passions and rivalries that will change everyone's destinies.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Ana experiences yet another heartbreak. Chico tries to take Henrique to live with him. Ana fulfills her dream of becoming a mother. Miguel is sent on a mission to Passaperto. Laura meets Miguel.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Laura and Miguel rekindle their romance. Chico has a heated argument with Ana. Father Inácio introduces Miguel to Passaperto society. The town ball in Laura's honor takes place.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Dr. Escobar and Ana share a romantic moment. Cândida raises suspicions about what Miguel was doing in Passaperto. Ana despairs over a detail of the railway project in Passaperto.
